nom: Prequel Skin Universal Skin Solution Hypochlorous Acid Spray for Face and Body. Fine Mist HOCL Facial Cleanser and Derma

avis.texte: This is an excellent product! My dermatologist recommended I try a Hypochlorous Acid Spray to clear up the odor in my right armpit (I know, TMI) that I was struggling with. I saw Prequel recommended online and when I realized that it is Accepted by the National Rosacea Society (this label is on the container) I decided to try this one, as I have suffered from Rosacea in the past and was currently quite red on both sides of my face and hadn't had any luck with over the counter remedies. I like the size of the bottle and I am really impressed with the spritzer, it sprays a fine mist. It is very lightweight, and there is no tingling or stinging or scent when I sprayed it on my body anywhere. I spray this like deodorant on my armpits immediately after showering and drying off and it has done an excellent job of killing the bacteria that soap and water wouldn't wash off. I also decided to start spraying this on both sides of my face after washing and drying to see if it could help with my redness. I just let it dry and then add my deodorant or my makeup (depending on where I had sprayed it). One day after having used it for 1-2 weeks I looked in the mirror and I realized that the redness on both sides of my face had gotten better! It wasn't gone, but it was not as red!! I can't tell you how happy I was just for the reduction in redness! I also spray it on my upper back and chest to help with minor acne as well, since I have oily skin there. avis.titre: The Best Dermal Spray I Have Found So Far
avis.texte: This is the best lotion I have found to calm my reactive skin. I have had eczema my whole life. I use this spray before applying the highly moisturizing Aveeno Eczema Therapy Nighttime Itch Relief Balm on my extremities and back. This spray helps calm my skin. I use it after my morning shower. It is not the end all of skin treatments, but it seems to be as helpful as prescription strength steroid cream. For a great eczema treatment,a soak in a hyper-salinic solution for 20 minutes will clear up much eczema if repeated for three days in a row. To make the hyper-salinic solution in your bath, pour table salt , ice cream salt, or kosher salt in the bottom of your tub until no more will go into solution. That means there will still be salt on the bottom of the tub. You may rinse off in the shower after the soak. A soak in the Dead Sea in Israel is even better. However, that is a long trip. If you happen to travel to Israel, take advantage of the Dead Sea soak. I recommend this dermal spray to help alleviate itching.

avis.titre: Helping the redness, at least somewhat
avis.texte: I have Type I rosacea, which means mostly I have redness and flushing. It has gotten better since I learned more about my skincare routine, and my rosacea. But there is still lingering redness and sometimes stinging if I'm not careful. This seems to be helping - while not completing erasing all the redness, I see a reduction. It took a couple of weeks - it isn't instantaneous, at least for me. It doesn't sting or burn going on. There is a slight 'chlorine or bleachy' scent but it's not bleach! It's very gentle. But do a patch test to be sure - always patch test. Can be a little drying so be sure to moisturize. And don't over-use it. I only do once a day and I don't spray much. I spray this on my clean dry skin and let it air dry. I don't use anything underneath it, not even toner, so I don't spray it in the mornings or evenings when I am using toners, serums/actives. This doesn't last long if you use it daily. Likely I'll start using it every other day and if my skin does okay, I'll continue with that. Absorbs quickly.

I’ve been using this spray for a while now, and I really like it. It’s very gentle on my skin, doesn’t sting, and leaves my face feeling fresh and clean. I also use it after workouts and before applying my skincare products. The fine mist is great, and the bottle lasts a long time. I will definitely keep buying it!

I have rosacia, pretty bad blotches on my cheeks and blushed redness on my neck, upper chest and t zone. Now previous to this i was using Tower 28 which is an awesome spray, it does a great job HOWEVER...this does a better job for a better price point so definitely switching. My redness have calmed considerably with daily use. I use it a min 2 times daily after cleansing and before skincare routine but o often find myself spritzing as needed during the day and even with full make-up it plays well. Love love love this.

3.5/5. Reduced redness wonderfully and somehow decreased the look of my pores. However, the spray goes everywhere and when it gets on my arms and legs, the stickiness makes me want to commit crimes. Which isnt helped by the fact that it's very hard to remove on arms and legs as soon as it goes on. A very helpful but very messy product.

So Buy buy buy
Works amazingly well! It is a perfect dupe for the Tower 28 spray at a much better price. The smell is fine and totally manageable. Highly recommend!

I’ve been using the Prequel Universal Skin Spray with Hypochlorous Acid for a few weeks now, and it has completely transformed my skincare routine. As someone with sensitive skin, I’m always cautious about introducing new products, but this spray has exceeded my expectations. First off, it’s hypoallergenic, which is a huge plus for me. I didn’t experience any irritation or redness, which is a common issue with other products. The formula is incredibly gentle yet effective, making it suitable for all skin types, including those with the most sensitive skin. What really impressed me was how versatile this spray is. I use it as a toner after cleansing, as a setting spray after applying makeup, and even to soothe any minor skin irritations or breakouts. It leaves my skin feeling refreshed, hydrated, and calm, without any sticky or greasy residue. Another bonus is the packaging – it’s sleek, easy to use, and perfect for on-the-go application. I love that I can carry it in my bag and spritz it anytime I need a quick refresh. For the price I cannot get enough! If you’re looking for a multi-purpose skincare product that delivers results, I highly recommend giving the Prequel Universal Skin Spray a try. It’s become a staple in my routine, and I can’t imagine my skincare regimen without it!

avis.titre: A must-have in my skincare routine
avis.texte: I’m obsessed with this Prequel Universal Skin Solution Dermal Spray. From the very first use, I noticed a refreshing and soothing feeling on my skin. It’s ultra-light, leaves no residue or sticky feeling, and absorbs in seconds. I use it after cleansing and before my serum, and I’ve noticed a big difference: my skin feels more hydrated, calmer, and the texture has improved. It’s also helped reduce occasional redness and keeps my skin barrier balanced—especially during stressful days or sudden weather changes. The spray format is super convenient—perfect for on-the-go use or even over makeup when I need a quick hydration boost. Plus, the formula is minimal and clean, which I really appreciate as someone with sensitive skin. Highly recommended! It’s become a daily essential for me.

avis.titre: Lovely extra fine mist that soothes the skin
avis.texte: I love the mist on this sprayer. It’s very fine and does not leave your skin super wet or with large droplets of product. It soaks right in and does not leave a film. Very easy to apply. I was recommended this to keep the bacterial load down on my face as I have been through 2 rounds of antibiotics for peri oral dermatitis.
I use this spray everyday! I do think it’s why keeps my acne from coming back, I spray in the morning and night time. Great for oily skin, leaves a glowy look. Will be reordering.
Refrescante, muy bueno me ayuda a desinflamar cuando tengo brotes de acné lo único malo es el olor.

I have very dry and sensitive skin. I get rashes on face and body spring-summer due to my allergies. Have taken allergies shots, pills and ointments to help and honestly i was still miserable. Came across TikTok video of a girl saying it helped her rosacea ( i know not the same thing but i was desperate)not going to lie the smell of bleach is strong BUT it is the only thing that has helped my skin in 15 yrs. The second picture is about 24 hrs difference and usually by day 2 my rash even with prescription meds & ointments would be red and so itchy but no it really did calm my skin drastically. I even bought the travel size one from target to take with me on vacation, i tried it once after mosquito bite and it helped calm the itchiness. Will continue to buy.

The first photo is of the new formula and the second photo is of the old formula. I loved the original formula of this spray so I bought another when I finished my bottle. As soon as I sprayed the new bottle I could tell that they had changed it. The original formula had a very mild chlorine smell and the new formula is an overpowering metallic smell. It’s horrible, like I sprayed penny water on my face. I immediately checked the ingredients on both bottles and noticed the difference with the original having sodium phosphate and disodium phosphate while the new one scraped those ingredients for just ethanoic acid. I assume the change in ingredients is what caused the change in smell. I’ve only used the new once so I’m not sure yet ,but I hope the results of the spray are the same. I wouldn’t recommend purchasing if you’re sensitive to smells.

avis.titre: Rust - This isn’t safe for your skin- Recall immediately
avis.texte: I’ve used Hypochlorous for over 10 years, this has a very strong smell to it 200 ppm is over kill and the packaging is showing rust around the base of the spray head. This product measures at 3.4 pH, it is very acidic, the acidity is causing the spring to rust, or the spring is not compliant to coexist with the HOCL. This is a public warning that this product needs to have a voluntary recall. Not quality HOCL- sorry

Because I had never heard of hypochlorous acid, or known anyone who used it, I was hesitant to add it to my skincare routine. I originally bought it to keep with my first aid kit after hearing how Dr. Ellis described it. My dermatologist recently prescribed me Tretinoin and my skin was freaking out bad. So remembering what Sam said about its healing benefits, I decided to try it in my routine and OH MY GOODNESS, I'm so glad I did!!! It has helped calm my skin significantly! And when my skin starts peeling throughout the day from the purging, I just spray some of this on my face and it works it's miracle magic. I was so blown away, I even decided to use it as a deodorant today and it worked BETTER than any deodorant I have ever tried. Guys. I cannot praise this product enough. I really look forward to discovering all of its wonderful uses.
I love that it’s safe and gentle on eyelids, face, body, etc.

The mister on this is AMAZING! Love using this before dermarolling or when my rosacea is flared up to calm my skin. Kinda smells like pool water or bleach when it first sprays so don’t let that freak you out - it’s good stuff!
As a teacher this is a necessity in the classroom. This was recommended by a colleague who swears by it. It’s easy to use and has a clean smell. The bottle is a great size for travel.

It’s now a staple in my routine, especially when my skin is feeling sensitive. I highly recommend it for anyone with reactive skin!
